title: ZeroDocs Demo
description: A live example site showing what ZeroDocs renders from plain Markdown.
_comment: No github block on purpose: this demo ships inside the software repo and is not user-editable content, so it shows no 'Edit this page on GitHub' link. A real site adds a github block pointing at its own content repo (see docs.config.example.json).
